raw_text: ☀️🌿✨ Good morning, Oleg! For your natal chart (born May 23, 1978, at 00:50 in Chisinau), your exact Ascendant is Aquarius (1°32') with your Midheaven in Scorpio (28°46'), and today the Full Moon in Gemini activates your 4th house while the Sun illuminates your 10th house of career. On this Wednesday, November 25, 2026, ruled by Mercury during the 17th lunar day, intellectual clarity and sharp communication set the pace for your day. 🪐 Planetary Influences Today Transiting Mercury in Scorpio forms an exact conjunction with your natal Uranus (0.08°), sparking sudden insights and unconventional solutions in your professional sphere. Meanwhile, transiting Neptune in Aries creates a harmonious sextile to both your natal Sun and your Aquarius Ascendant, enhancing your intuition, though its square to your natal Venus (0.01°) calls for realism in financial and personal expectations. With transiting Saturn retrograde in Aries squaring your natal Jupiter, disciplined pacing is essential to balance ambition with practical limits. 💼 Work, Business & Finance With the Sun in your 10th house and Mercury energizing your analytical mind, today is ideal for strategic planning, auditing contracts, and high-stakes negotiations. Schedule your most important business calls, financial discussions, and deal signings during your peak planetary windows in Chisinau: 09:36–10:21 (Jupiter) for expansion and partnerships, 11:06–11:51 (Sun) for executive decisions, and 11:51–12:36 (Venus) for diplomatic agreements. ❤️ Personal Relationships & Communication The Full Moon in Gemini in your 4th house heightens emotional sensitivity around home and family matters, while transiting Venus in Libra forms a supportive sextile to your natal Saturn, favoring mature and loyal dialogue. Keep your tone clear and grounded in both personal and business interactions to avoid misunderstandings fueled by Neptune's square to Venus. 🌿 Health & Vitality Your vitality is steady, supported by Mars and Jupiter in Leo, yet the Full Moon energy can create mental restlessness or nervous tension. Prioritize hydration, take short breaks between intense negotiations, and unwind in the evening with a calm walk or light stretching to release accumulated stress. 💡 Wise Advice for Today To neutralize the tension from Saturn's square to your natal Jupiter and Neptune's square to Venus, double-check all financial figures, avoid impulsive commitments, and ground yourself before reacting to unexpected news. Channel Mercury's sharp focus into organizing documents and refining your long-term strategy. ✨ Today's Blessing May this Wednesday bring you crystal-clear judgment, steady confidence, and harmonious breakthroughs in every endeavor you pursue.
